title: [spec-gap][R-CCP12-015] §4.4 desync step 1 'fall back to CH0 listening' not evidenced in any stack
description: Sweep docs/spec-coverage/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md. Desync recovery steps 2-4 (3 consecutive valid beacons, SFN resync from beacon, resume hopping) are implemented+tested: rust DesyncFSM RECOVERY_BEACONS=3 (lichen-core/src/desync.rs:44,140-158) + ccp16-desync.json consumers (lichen-core/tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs, lichen-rpl/tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs); python DesyncFSM + TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES=3 (timing/sfn.py:14,60-174) + sync_from_beacon (sim/tdma.py:67-92); C tests/desync_fsm/main.c:186-196 with _Static_assert(timeout==3). Step 1 'fall back to CH0 listening' has no explicit channel action anywhere (no CH0/channel reference in desync.rs, sfn.py, C desync FSM); beacon listening is implicitly CH0 only because beacons are control traffic. Suggested: either document implicit-CH0 conformance (data-TX suppression while DESYNCED/RECOVERING) in the spec, or add an explicit park-on-CH0 radio action + vector; decide which stack owns it.
